stages.stranger: Bruno, meu irmão, nice to meet you! I'm a templar, and I box, and I smile more than a templar should. Rory says so, and I tell him somebody in the Order has to.
stages.acquaintance: I'm from Curitiba, in the south of Brazil. My father left when I was small, and my mother, Dona Graça, raised me. At fifteen I walked into a gym above a tyre shop and met Seu Valdir, who made me a fighter. Twenty-three fights, eighteen wins, all in little halls full of noise. I was better than the record, tá bom?
stages.companion: My mother came to every fight and covered her eyes for all of them. I always found her in the crowd before the bell, hands over her face. I was wrapping my hands at the gym when the world changed, and I came to in the Plaguelands with this roll of hand-wrap in my pocket. It's from my last fight. I won it. I haven't found her.
stages.friend: I joined the Scarlet Crusade, at the start. They were winning, and they wanted big men who could fight, and they taught me the Light. I kept that part. Now there's a Scarlet unit getting ready to purge a transplant settlement, and Kleber's leading it, a Brazilian boy I taught to box in their camp. I want to ask him to walk away, like I did. Bora, will you come?
stages.sworn: He wouldn't walk away. We fought the way I taught him, and I won, and he died, and the settlement's safe. I sat with him a long time. I taught Kleber to fight and the Crusade taught him the rest, and I should have gone back for him. Last night I told Rory everything about the camp, without waiting for him to start, and it took until morning. Forty Scarlets came over to us this winter because of Kleber, and I train every one. Keep the wrap, meu irmão. I don't fight for wins any more.

moments.prompt: Bruno has squared up in front of you and he's offering to teach you a jab.

options.reply: Isso, chin down, elbow in! Valeu, you're a natural.
Tá bom, but I'm asking again tomorrow, and the day after that.

moments.prompt: He's asked you to come and face Kleber with him.

options.reply: Valeu, meu irmão. Let me talk to him first, please, before anything else happens.
Then I do what I've got to. But I ask him first, always.

lines.bored_warning: Meu irmão, we're shadowboxing out here. I want a real opponent.
lines.leaving_good: Bora, that was a great trip! I'm off to the Bulwark to see how my recruits are getting on without me.
lines.leaving_bored: My recruits at the Bulwark need me more than this does. Back to the gym for me.
lines.after_wipe: Up, up, meu irmão! A knockdown isn't a knockout, and we're getting up.
lines.wipe_warning: My corner would've thrown the towel in by now, meu irmão. Last round, and then the Bulwark for a while.
lines.wipe_leave: That's the fight over for me, tá bom? I'll be at the Bulwark, icing everything.
lines.zone_warning: Meu irmão, we're giving away fifty pounds to everything out here. Seu Valdir would never let me take this fight.
lines.zone_leave: Seu Valdir never let me take a fight I couldn't win, and he was right. I'll be in the Order's quarter at the Bulwark.
lines.gear_refuse: Ah, no, meu irmão, that's mine. Train with me a while first.
lines.gear_taken: Pode pegar, take it. I've fought in less.
lines.gear_short: My guard's a bit open without that piece, meu irmão. Find me something, bora?
lines.gear_upgrade: Valeu, that's beautiful! I'll fight even better now, if that's possible.
lines.back: The recruits can all throw a jab now, more or less! Bora, where are we going?
lines.send_word: Bruno has sent word from the Bulwark. He's wrapped his hands and he's ready.
lines.walkout_talk: Meu irmão, walking off like that was a cheap shot, and I hate cheap shots. Sit down and let me explain.
lines.neglect: Ei, there's my favourite! I've been shadowboxing your ghost for weeks.
lines.asked_to_stay: Bora, one more round! I love one more round.
lines.on_break: Bruno is back in the Order's quarter at the Bulwark, training recruits. Come back after you've done a few more jobs.
lines.quest_abandoned: We quit in the first round on that one, meu irmão. I hate quitting.
lines.mail_yes: Bora, I'm coming! I'll be in {town}, warming up. Get ready for one more round!
lines.mail_later: Meu irmão, the recruits have their first real bout this week and I'm in their corner. After the bout, I'm yours.
lines.mail_see_me: Meu irmão, no cheap shots, so no letters. Come to the Bulwark and let me explain.

town_arrive.text: My mother made feijoada every Saturday, and the whole street knew it by the smell. I'd eat a whole pot of it right now.

boss_down.text: Down and out! Good work, everybody, now shake your hands out.

close_call.text: Chin down, meu irmão! You walked straight into that one.

dungeon_clear.text: Good rounds in there, all of you. Seu Valdir would have liked this team.
